name: Antinuous
long_description:
Antinuous is building the platform to run 100x more research, experiments, and simulations, 1,000x cheaper.

The platform combines a research agent, compute clusters, and hardware-tuned simulation software to give every agent access to research primitives that are typically reserved for massive R&D orgs, saving days per week on research iteration.
one_liner: Autonomous research agents for R&D and applied science
